title: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A small, chatty, thieving Gateless girl born to the Gruul who tails Master Zarek for Hekara, adopts the newly arrived Teyo and fights the Eternals.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A bell-haired Rakdos emissary and Rat's best friend and role model, who is reported dead at the end.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A young acolyte of the Shieldmage Order from the plane of Gobakhan who unexpectedly planeswalks to Ravnica and protects people with light shields.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet guildmaster and planeswalker who shuts himself away with Niv-Mizzet, summons allies and fights Eternals with lightning.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: The Orzhov guildmaster and planeswalker who fights Eternals with ghostly daggers and tells Rat that Hekara is dead.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who invades Ravnica through a giant portal from atop a new pyramid.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon Izzet guildmaster whose experiment with Zarek explodes.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The gorgon Golgari guildmaster who assassinated Isperia.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The missing Living Guildpact who is among the planeswalkers who arrive to fight the Eternals.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Jace's former assistant and an Azorius officer who arrives with the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A large sword-wielding planeswalker who leads the defense against the Dreadhorde and calls Teyo Teyonraht.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives with the fighters.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fiery-haired pyromancer planeswalker who arrives to fight the Eternals.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A gray-haired precision pyromancer planeswalker fighting the Eternals.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A one-eyed leonin planeswalker who arrives with the fighters.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver, sentient automaton who arrives with the fighters.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A raven-haired planeswalker in a black dress who dons a golden veil that glows with purple tattoos and commands the Eternal army; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Abbot Barrez
entities.description: The head of Teyo's monastery on Gobakhan.

entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: A centaur who is Rat's godfather.

entities.name: The Eternals
entities.description: Undead lazotep-covered warriors of metallic blue who march through the portal and kill everyone in their path.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild Rat was born into, to which her parents want her to commit.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of demon revelers, for whom Hekara is emissary.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of chemisters led by Niv-Mizzet, with Ral Zarek as its guildmaster.

entities.name: Shieldmage Order
entities.description: A monastic order on Gobakhan that protects people from diamondstorms with shield magic, of which Teyo is an acolyte.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane being invaded by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Gobakhan
entities.description: Teyo's desert home plane that suffers diamondstorms.

entities.name: Transguild Promenade
entities.description: A bridge and thoroughfare in Ravnica where Rat meets Hekara and Teyo.

entities.name: Tenth District Plaza
entities.description: The plaza where Bolas's obelisk and pyramid have risen and the portal opens.

entities.name: Embassy of the Guildpact
entities.description: The building cut in half by the portal's arrival.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The Izzet guildhall where Rat tails Zarek.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The title of a magical arbiter, held by Jace, whose rulings resolve guild disputes.

events.summary: Rat meets her friend Hekara on the Transguild Promenade and reports on tailing Ral Zarek to Nivix, where he and Niv-Mizzet had an exploding experiment.
events.quote: Something about a beacon being their only chance now.

events.summary: Hekara receives Zarek's summons to activate the beacon and tells Rat to take the night off.
Hekara leaves, calling Rat by her full name, and Rat wanders the city until dawn when Hekara does not show.
events.quote: She wasn't there. I waited, but she didn't come.

events.summary: Teyo materializes on the Promenade covered in sand, and Rat adopts him.
events.quote: And as a sand-covered boy materialized right in front of me.

events.summary: Rat learns Teyo is from Gobakhan and an acolyte of the Shieldmage Order and explains that he has planeswalked to Ravnica.
events.quote: Teyo, I've a feeling you're not on Gobakhan anymore.

events.summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
events.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

events.summary: Rat and Teyo arrive at Tenth District Plaza and find a new obelisk and pyramid crowned with dragon statues.
events.quote: Sometime—sometime very recently—it had risen out of the ground, displacing buildings and gardens and whatever else used to be there.

events.summary: A giant portal opens and splits the Embassy of the Guildpact, killing bystanders, and Bolas gloats from his pyramid.
events.quote: A gigantic portal—easily fifty yards tall—had opened up behind us, instantly decimating the Embassy of the Guildpact, sheering it right in half.

events.summary: A raven-haired woman puts on a golden veil, her skin glows with purple tattoos, and she commands the marching Eternal army to slaughter the crowd.
events.quote: the army stopped as one and turned to look her way

events.summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
Teyo shields Kaya from a mineralized minotaur while Rat stabs it, and Zarek electrocutes it.
events.quote: He stood over Mistress Kaya, erecting a triangular shield of light to protect her and himself from the creature.

events.summary: Zarek's goggles identify Teyo as a Planeswalker, and Kaya asks if there are others.
Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
events.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

events.summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
events.quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

events.summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
events.quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

events.summary: Kaya tells Rat that Hekara is dead, devastating Rat.

relations.quote: she was my best mate, my hero, my role model.

relations.note: She adopts him as family and fights beside him.

relations.quote: My girl Hekara was emissary to the demon Rakdos

relations.note: Zarek works under the Izzet dragon.
relations.quote: He shut himself away with his boss.

relations.note: He invades Ravnica with the Dreadhorde.

relations.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

relations.note: She commands his Eternal army through the veil.
relations.quote: she ordered her shining forces to turn and march toward everyone
I'm an acolyte of the Shieldmage Order.
there's this centaur I know, but he's kinda my godfather
